notes.title: Happy holidays from BerserkBoy Games! ❄️❄️
notes.content:
Happy Holidays from BerserkBoy Games! 

Without you all, we wouldn’t be able to do this. So thank you for all of your support in 2024.

I hope you all have a brilliant festive period + new year! 

- and if you’req new to Berserk Boy, please do leave a review if you’re having a good time! It really helps us out ❤️

Have a great new year!

notes.title: BERSERK BOY LAUNCHES TOMORROW!
notes.content:
it's pretty surreal to believe launch is just around the corner. Development has gone on for 5 years in total and there were times where it felt the finished product would never be in sight.

I'm truly so thankful to anyone who's wishlisted, played the demo, spoken about the project  to others or is even considering purchasing the game tomorrow. 

It's all anyone can want really. 

To celebrate the occasion we have some killer artwork by @AngryangryDon socials) for the occasion! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40610492/cbcd91215c9a5a786fdff5ea7bac4a34d083af76.png[/img]


- Love
Zu <3

notes.title: BERSREKBOY DEV STREAM! GO BERSERK!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you for the awesome reception with the Steam page being live again. ːsteamhappyː

In honor of GamesCom we were going to relaunch the demo, however I said if we managed to get enough wishlists, I'd not just reupload the demo but update it as well.

So ... As we managed to hit that goal, we've DONE JUST THAT!ːsteamhappyː

THE NEW DEMO INCLUDES:

* 10 Different Languages
* 2 Stages (and hidden things)
*Accessibility options
*High pace and action packed gameplay!
*Secret

(Come watch me stream and show off the demo!)


And please make sure youWishlist today!
